t:
(a) Training Required.—Subchapter IV of chapter 43 is amended by adding at the end the following new section:“§ 4335. Training for Federal executive agency human resources personnel on employment and reemployment rights and limitations“(a) Training Required.—The head of each Federal executive agency shall provide training for the human resources personnel of such agency on the following:“(1) The rights, benefits, and obligations of members of the uniformed services under this chapter.“(2) The application and administration of the requirements of this chapter by such agency with respect to such members.“(b) Consultation.—The training provided under subsection (a) shall be developed and provided in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management.“(c) Frequency.—The training under subsection (a) shall be provided with such frequency as the Director of the Office of Personnel Management shall specify in order to ensure that the human resources personnel of Federal executive agencies are kept fully and currently informed of the matters covered by the training.“(d) Human Resources Personnel Defined.—In this section, the term ‘human resources personnel’, in the case of a Federal executive agency, means any personnel of the agency who are authorized to recommend, take, or approve any personnel action that is subject to the requirements of this chapter with respect to employees of the agency.”
. 
    (b) Clerical Amendment.—The table of sections at the beginning of chapter 43 is amended by adding at the end the following new item:


“4335. 
Training for Federal executive agency human resources personnel on employment and reemployment rights and limitations.”.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that the "Consultation" subsection signals participation. But the consultation is between heads of Federal executive agencies and the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, who are all inside the federal government. The section only requires internal training for federal human resources personnel; no state, tribe, expert, company, or member of the public is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: The training provided under subsection (a) shall be developed and provided in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management.

qwen_block.w: The section requires federal agency heads to train their own human resources personnel. The consultation mentioned is with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, who is a federal official. Since both the agency heads and the Director of OPM are inside the federal government, this is intra-governmental coordination, not participation by outside parties.
qwen_block.s: The training provided under subsection (a) shall be developed and provided in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management.

opus.w: The only consultation the section requires is between federal executive agency heads and the Director of the Office of Personnel Management. That is coordination inside the federal government, not outside participation. The "Consultation" heading is tempting, but no state, tribe, expert, company or member of the public takes part in any federal decision here.
opus.s: The training provided under subsection (a) shall be developed and provided in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management.
opus.b: The word "Consultation" makes this look like participation. It isn't: the consultation is with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, who is a federal official. The training is for federal HR staff and is delivered by federal agency heads, so no one outside the federal government is involved.

qwen_chat.w: The section requires consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, who is a federal official. The training is for federal human resources personnel. Since all parties involved (the consulting agency, the consulted agency, and the trainees) are within the federal government, this is intra-governmental coordination, not participation by outside parties.
qwen_chat.s: (b) Consultation.—The training provided under subsection (a) shall be developed and provided in consultation with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: The section mentions "consultation" with the Director of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM). One might think this constitutes participation because it involves coordination before a decision (developing training) is made. However, the Director of OPM is a federal official, and the training is for federal employees. Therefore, all actors involved (the agency heads, the HR personnel, and the OPM Director) are inside the federal government. Intra-governmental coordination does not count as participation under the definition.
